findings.message: recursive closure walkInvocation walks xdr.SorobanAuthorizedInvocation with no depth cap; nesting is chosen by the transaction submitter or a contract, so pass a depth counter and stop at a fixed limit
a contract-supplied string (xdr.ScString) is converted to string and used without a UTF-8 check; its bytes are arbitrary, so validate with utf8.ValidString (and cap its length) first

participants is filled from the transaction envelope with no check that the transaction succeeded; the envelope records what the submitter claimed, so derive participants from the ledger meta or return only the source account for a failed transaction

MuxedAccount.Address() returns the M... form for a muxed account, whose 64-bit ID stellar-core does not validate; call ToAccountId() first or branch on the account Type before using it as an account key

the address in a declared Soroban authorization entry is read as fact; the host never checks entries that no require_auth call matched, so confirm it against the ledger meta (the nonce entry the host creates) before trusting it
memo text is read with GetText() and used without a UTF-8 check; stellar-core accepts any 28 bytes, so validate with utf8.ValidString or store it as bytes
